I need to use the web_fetch tool directly to access the arXiv API. Let me construct the API query URL properly.

```python
query = 'all:"multimodal" AND all:"retrieval augmented generation"'
url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start=0&max_results=20&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'

result = web_fetch(url=url)
print(result)
```
